plane.model: forest UtilityPlane v13 (source/plane/UtilityPlane_Unity_v13), the WinterKit 1.2 installed
plane.tarp: PlaneTarp: child of the plane root at (0, 0, 0), no rotation
plane.note: the plane itself is not part of this package; the tarp was draped with the plane in this pose

meta.frame: each root in its own frame: z up, the front -y; BunkerHangar: origin on the floor in the middle of the gate line; BlastDoor: the floor in the middle of its open end; BunkerEntrance: the ground at the top step's edge; PlaneTarp: forest UtilityPlane's own frame. Every pivot / pos here is in its root's frame. In bunker.blend the roots stand apart (display_offset; the vestibule at its link behind the hangar); their FBX is exported with the root at the origin
meta.unity: position (x, y, z) -> Unity (-x, z, -y) in the prefab; axis likewise; angle -> -angle (Unity is left-handed); box centre likewise, size (sx, sy, sz) -> (sx, sz, sy); Euler XYZ (x, y, z) -> Unity (x, -z, y); the root's front (-y) is the prefab's +Z
meta.assembly: BlastDoor on BunkerHangar Link_BlastDoor (no rotation); the plane on Slot_Plane, PlaneTarp under the plane root; BunkerEntrance by the hand on the lake, joined to the hangar's Link_SideDoor by the underground part (not in this package) from its Link_Shaft
meta.colliders: BoxCollider per type box entry on its parent (center / size in the parent's own frame, optional rotation); type hit: a trigger box of a removable ice chunk. The COL_ / HIT_ objects are in the .blend for reference (collection Colliders), not in the FBX
meta.lights: bunker_lights.json: the hangar's six pendant lamps (spots), its door and back lamps, the vestibule's two, the portal's one (all off in the file: the bunker has no power until the players bring it)
meta.materials: M_Bunker_Hangar / _HangarParts / _BlastDoor / _Entrance / _Tarp: baked PSX atlases (point filter; M_Bunker_Tarp: Render Face Both); M_Bunker_Panel: signs and the door console; M_Bunker_Lamp_Off / M_Bunker_Lamp: the lamps' glasses off / lit (lit kept by a fake user); M_Bunker_Prints: wet boot prints, alpha cut-out; M_Bunker_IceClear: the ice on the entrance landing, box-mapped (UV 1 = 1 m, the tile repeats), opacity 0.35 (one layer: no underside)
meta.names: the doors IX_* without numbers - Unity numbers them when it places them
